    ebits = req['ebits']
    fbits = req['fbits']

    F = 1 << fbits
    Eall = (1 << ebits) - 1

    emax = Eall - 1 - bias  # == bias
    fmask = F - 1
    spos = ebits + fbits  # sign bit position

    # decode: returns ('fin'|'inf'|'nan', sign, m, E) with value = (-1)^sign * m * 2^E

        v = int(h, 16)
        s = (v >> spos) & 1
        e = (v >> fbits) & Eall
        f = v & fmask
        if e == Eall:

                return (1, s, 0, 0)          # infinity
            return (2, s, f, 0)              # NaN (m holds fraction)

import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
random.seed(7)
reqs=[]
# corner formats
for ebits,fbits in [(3,2),(3,52),(11,2),(11,52),(5,10),(8,23),(4,40),(10,20)]:
    if 1+ebits+fbits>64: continue
    N=1<<(1+ebits+fbits)
    for _ in range(1500):
        k=random.randint(0,64)
        reqs.append({"ebits":ebits,"fbits":fbits,"mode":random.choice(["RNE","RNA","RTZ","RUP","RDN"]),
                     "pairs":[[format(random.randrange(N),'x'),format(random.randrange(N),'x')] for _ in range(k)]])
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'main.py'],input='\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+'\n',
                 text=True,capture_output=True,cwd='/app')
dt=time.time()-t0
assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr
lines=p.stdout.splitlines()
assert len(lines)==len(reqs), (len(lines),len(reqs))
for l in lines:
    o=json.loads(l); assert set(o)>= {'bits','flags'}
print(f'{len(reqs)} requests in {dt:.2f}s (incl. process start)')
EOF
